description: SQL-aggregated read-only inventory of the WHOLE session ledger in ONE call -- 'which sources, how much content, any duplicate source rows, any orphan batches' over the entire corpus (the paginated read APIs clamp limit and cannot count a ~1M-event corpus). Per source it returns counts (sessions split canonical/sibling, events, tool_calls), batch health (owned_running_batches vs unclaimed_route_batches, oldest_running_batch_age_seconds), the raw root_uri + its normalized form, and an order-independent row_identity_fingerprint (bit_xor over event ids + content-blob ids under two seeds, proving the event/blob SET is unchanged without materializing a multi-MB string). Top level returns source_count, duplicate_source_groups (count of (source_kind, normalized root_uri) keys with more than one live row -- the duplicate-source signal), and total_sessions / total_events / total_tool_calls / total_owned_running_batches / total_unclaimed_route_batches. Read-only; mutates nothing.
